description: Optional memory eye-tracking datasets. Data, conversion products and run receipts remain outside Git. Unimplemented checks are BLOCKED, never successful by discovery alone.

datasets.title: FIGRIM target-image fixation locations and recognition responses
datasets.source_evidence: Downloaded the published target MATLAB file; inspected Nx2 location arrays and SDT vectors. Source commit is pinned.
caveats: No fixation durations or onsets: spatial occupancy only.
Observer slot j is preserved across images as documented; slots are not asserted to be unique people across recording sessions.
Missing phases and out-of-frame points are reported, not silently omitted.
Known duplicate images are excluded from control identities.

analysis.reason: Run a location-only spatial check through eyes4s and an independent NumPy oracle.

geometry.conversion: round as in author code, filter to 1..1000, subtract one

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses.

datasets.source_evidence: Paper Open Practices statement says data/materials for all experiments are at the TU Berlin project page; study has 28 observers and encoding/recall eye movements.
caveats: Format and dataset-specific license not stated; paper is CC BY 4.0. Legacy HTTP host may be unavailable.

acquisition.instructions: Legacy source host availability and release file inventory unresolved; paired gaze format/event markers need inspection.

analysis.reason: Legacy source host availability and release file inventory unresolved; paired gaze format/event markers need inspection.

datasets.title: Neural and behavioral reinstatement jointly reflect retrieval of narrative events (Sherlock, 2025)

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses. OSF license lookup: 'license'

datasets.source_evidence: OpenNeuro ds001132 supplies fMRI/spoken recall (n=16); OSF baw39 supplies MRI eye tracking (n=13), desktop eye tracking (availability statement n=23; methods n=21), preprocessed eye-voxel data, transcripts and code; OSF mrhk9 supplies DeepMReye weights.
caveats: ds001132 is BIDS/NIfTI plus behavior. Camera eye tracking is viewing-only; no in-scanner camera tracking during recall and desktop recall tracking was largely unusable. DeepMReye recall is MRI eye-signal inference, not camera recall data.

analysis.reason: Needs separate camera-viewing and DeepMReye-recall adapters plus narrative-event alignment; cannot qualify as paired camera gaze.

datasets.title: Johansson et al. 2022 eye-movement replay

license.name: No license
license.scope: OSF project; third-party stimuli may have separate terms

datasets.source_evidence: Paper states data/materials are on OSF; object-arrangement stimuli are available there. 60 analyzed adults; SMI RED-M at 120 Hz. Scene stimuli came from MIT CAT2000: http://saliency.mit.edu/datasets.html. Inspected the downloaded workbook container and shared-string schema: figure/table sheets contain derived replay, MultiMatch, AOI, rating and response measures; no individual fixation-coordinate fields were found.
caveats: Raw format and data license not specified; mixed stimulus provenance/rights.
Root OSF d9zng contains stimuli; child g72qb contains Source data_for_DOI_10.1098_rspb.2022.0964.xlsx. Figshare 20025825 contains a supplementary DOCX, not a verified raw-gaze archive.

analysis.reason: Available source workbook contains derived measures and figure/table data; individual encoding/recall fixation sequences have not been located. Needs the actual sequence release before a new eyes4s replay analysis.

inspection.method: OOXML workbook sheet names and complete shared-string inventory
inspection.scope: metadata inspection, not full cell-level spreadsheet review

datasets.title: Brooks et al. 2024 emotional-memory reinstatement

license.name: MIT License
license.scope: OSF project; third-party stimuli may have separate terms

datasets.source_evidence: PLOS Data Availability states data files are on OSF. Two experiments, n=24 analyzed each; eye tracking, behavior and recognition measures.
caveats: OSF formats/license not established from paper. Stimuli include internet-sourced images; third-party rights may apply.

analysis.reason: OSF release accessible; fixation format, trial keys, scene regions and retrieval phases need a dataset-specific adapter.

license.scope: OSF project; third-party stimuli may have separate terms

analysis.reason: Needs per-experiment adapter, auditory probe timing, former-word-pair AOIs and immediate-retrieval alignment.

license.name: CC-By Attribution 4.0 International
license.scope: OSF project; third-party stimuli may have separate terms

datasets.title: Chiquet et al. 2022 imagery-related eye movements in 3D

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses.

datasets.source_evidence: Paper Data availability gives OSF encoding and recall links. 78 participants analyzed (7 excluded); immersive VR; 90 Hz binocular gaze-origin/direction vectors and AOI intersections.
caveats: Article CC BY 4.0; OSF file formats/license not verified.
w75qn and fu25r are file GUIDs, not project nodes; resolved through OSF guids API. Recall CSV exceeds the default 256 MiB download budget.

analysis.reason: 3D gaze/AOI CSVs require typed 3D-to-surface projection or an AOI-only analysis; do not reinterpret vectors as screen pixels.

datasets.title: Wynn-Ryan-Buchsbaum 2020 pattern completion

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses.

datasets.source_evidence: PNAS Data deposition says data and analysis code are available on GitHub. 57 analyzed participants; EyeLink II 500 Hz; 240 images/120 similar pairs with degradation.
caveats: Current repository contents and data license require inspection before redistribution; paper does not state a dataset license.

analysis.reason: R serialized fixation groups need conversion; study rows pool four presentations whose onsets restart, so temporal analysis must recover original trial boundaries.

datasets.title: Helbing-Draschkow-Vo 2026 Search Superiority Recollection Familiarity
datasets.source_evidence: NEMAR reports 30 participants, BEH+EEG, BIDS beh/eeg, 61 channels, 17.0 GB, CC0; OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005189.v1.0.1.
caveats: Git-annex/NEMAR download; stimuli/ and derivatives/ skipped unless explicitly requested.

acquisition.instructions: Use the pinned OpenNeuro 1.0.1 or NEMAR v1.0.0 release; select gaze/behavior files after inventory inspection. Do not download the 17 GB EEG dataset implicitly.

analysis.reason: Confirm individual eye traces and encoding/retrieval coverage in release; EEG/behavior availability alone is insufficient.

datasets.title: Wilming Memory I/II (Dryad complex-image eye movements)

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses.

datasets.source_evidence: Dryad inventory lists additional_samples/Memory_I_raw.hdf (115.49 MB), Memory_II_raw.hdf (68.50 MB), meta.csv, fixmat.py/get_fixmat.m and many other HDF/HDF5 experiment files; stimuli are separate ZIPs.
caveats: Dataset-specific license not exposed in retrieved metadata; broad multi-experiment collection, not only Memory I/II.

analysis.reason: HDF sample adapter, geometry, event/subject keys and memory-response metadata are unverified.

datasets.title: Wynn et al. 2025 Decoding memory function through naturalistic gaze patterns

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses. OSF license lookup: 'license'

datasets.source_evidence: Paper states anonymized fixation reports (CSV), subject demographics and model tables were deposited on OSF; naturalistic gaze study includes older-adult/MCI cohort.
caveats: Deposit is summarized/anonymized CSV plus demographics/model tables, not necessarily raw eye-tracker streams; license beyond stated CSV deposit unclear.

analysis.reason: Fixation-report CSV adapter needed; repeated viewing without explicit recognition/cued recall is a separate scientific scope.

license.note: No dataset-specific license verified; article licenses are not dataset licenses.

datasets.title: MoMoView Study Dataset
datasets.source_evidence: Zenodo record: N=179 ages 5-79, naturalistic scenes and degraded recognition; total 745.2 MB; CC BY 4.0.
caveats: Record exposes derived MultiMatch/DeepGaze CSVs and stimuli, not clearly raw per-sample eye-tracker streams.

analysis.reason: Current inventory provides derived scanpath-comparison tables and stimuli, not individual fixation sequences for a new reinstatement analysis.

datasets.title: Kragel et al. (2021): Rapid coordination of effective learning by the human hippocampus
datasets.source_evidence: Zenodo inventory and NEMAR README verified; six participants, EyeLink 500 Hz with hippocampal recordings.
caveats: EDF needs licensed vendor edf2asc conversion; eyes4s accepts ASC, not binary EDF.
NEMAR has no aligned events.tsv; reconstruct events using behavioral arrays, EyeLink messages and sync pulses.
Original ZIP is 9.16 GB; metadata readme can be fetched independently.

analysis.reason: EDF conversion and source-specific trial alignment required before eyes4s admission; no verified adapter yet.

datasets.title: CNeuroMod-THINGS (2026)

license.name: CC0
license.scope: Open paper release; do not substitute the separately registered-access Courtois dataset

datasets.source_evidence: Paper data-availability and release repository verified. Nested DataLad repositories reference eye-tracking TSV.gz plus sidecars and events.
caveats: Central-fixation instructions make free-viewing scanpath reinstatement inappropriate.
Git checkout or Zenodo source archive alone does not materialize annex data.
Select gaze, sidecar and event files; the fMRI corpus is not needed for the gaze check.

acquisition.instructions: Install DataLad and clone https://github.com/courtois-neuromod/cneuromod-things into the external dataset cache. Pin the clone and nested THINGS/fmriprep/sourcedata/things revisions before requesting selected *_eyetrack.tsv.gz, their JSON sidecars and *_events.tsv with datalad get. No recursive content fetch.

analysis.reason: DataLad materialization and TSV/JSON/events clock/frame adapter are not implemented; qualification limited to recognition and fixation compliance when added.
